p_convention.definition: p(b,c) = min(1, 2*P[Bin(b+c,1/2) <= min(b,c)]), p(0,0) = 1; exact integer arithmetic
p_convention.matches_R_binom_test: R stats::binom.test(x, n, 0.5)$p.value reduces to this by symmetry of the p0 = 1/2 binomial (its 'sum of densities <= observed' rule picks exactly the mirror tail)
p_convention.significance_rule: significant iff p <= alpha (fragility.R verdict_fragility / make_figs.R use `<=`)

definitions.kappa_dir: |b - c| (fragility.R sign_distance; BFS sign_fragility agrees on every state)
definitions.kappa_ver_bfs: fragility.R min_flips over four-cell states with the eight FLIP_MOVES, predicate = verdict flips (p<=alpha <-> p>alpha)
definitions.kappa_ver_closed_form_audit: significant: min{i+j : p(l-i, t+j) > alpha, 0<=i<=l, 0<=j<=n-m+i}; non-significant: min{i+j : p(l+i, t-j) <= alpha, 0<=j<=t, 0<=i<=n-m+j}; l=max(b,c), t=min(b,c); inf if empty
definitions.kappa_ver_closed_form_R: port of fragility.R verdict_distance() (Proposition 2 scan over m')

closed_form_verification.verdict: BFS == audit closed form == R closed form on every four-cell state
